_comment: Dashboard card plugin descriptor (drop-in folder). Fields: id (= folder name), label, icon, w/h (grid size), order (picker sort), live (fast-poll), sections (snapshot sections it reads), chart (timeseries kind), section + server (backend). See cards/README.md — do NOT register data cards in dashboard.js CARD_TYPES or add builders to server.py _build_snapshot().
